source_row.rationale: Applying a skin barrier cream (such as a zinc oxide or petrolatum-based product) to skin frequently exposed to moisture, stool, or other irritants helps protect the skin from prolonged exposure, reducing the risk of incontinence-associated dermatitis and subsequent skin breakdown — used in addition to, not as a replacement for, regular gentle cleansing after incontinence episodes.
